notes.title: Update Note 28.
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839894/d09d11991af05e33c7dd6bd6e270fbd198bbe149.png"]

Hello, this is Alpheratz*.
The hot summer is finally coming to an end—how was it for you?
For me, it was a whirlwind of events and preparations, as Connected Clue reaches the final stage of development while also being showcased at BIC and other exhibitions.

Here’s what I’ll be sharing in this development log:

GxG / GES2025 Exhibition News

Updates on the STEAM Store Page and Assets

Game Promotion and Events via Social Media

Official Website Updates

BIC Feedback & Gratitude

Current Progress



Official Website: 

https://www.connected-clue.com/


We’ve also opened the Steam store page and a merchandise shop! Please check them out.
Steam: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1777200/Connected_Clue/"][/dynamiclink]


Merch Shop: 

https://marpple.shop/kr/alpheratz4869








GxG / GES2025 Exhibition News



[previewyoutube="5-YZG8UjrUo;full"][/previewyoutube]


Connected Clue will be exhibited at IndieCraft GxG2025 from September 19–20.
You can find us at Booth #1, Sunken Plaza, Pangyo Station in Korea. We’d love for you to stop by, try the demo, and share your feedback!



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_4263f13064bc45ff83483a4e6f0015e5~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_571,h_800,al_c,q_85,enc_auto/104f30_4263f13064bc45ff83483a4e6f0015e5~mv2.jpg"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_b97d42bc04804b89847756b51716af1a~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_576,h_482,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_b97d42bc04804b89847756b51716af1a~mv2.jpg"]



In addition, from September 19–21, Connected Clue will also be showcased through our publisher CFK at GES2025, hosted by SBA at DDP Art Hall in Korea.
You can find us at Booth SG19 in the Seoul Game Ally zone. If you’re nearby, please drop by!


Exhibition Info:  https://x.com/CFK_NEWS_KR/status/1966378440623603830



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_27062861ce5f43f592089ac00734d2ab~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_532,h_752,al_c,lg_1,q_85,enc_auto/104f30_27062861ce5f43f592089ac00734d2ab~mv2.jpg"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_1ccca5e3037c44798805df5d5b3448ab~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_576,h_338,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_1ccca5e3037c44798805df5d5b3448ab~mv2.jpg"]






Steam Store Page and Assets Update
We’ve refreshed the Steam and STOVE store pages with updated descriptions and new screenshots.


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1777200"][/dynamiclink]

We’ve also completed promotional images for mobile stores.



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_c7d8be6e1e09469d98e68211894651c0~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_576,h_341,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_c7d8be6e1e09469d98e68211894651c0~mv2.jpg"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_ec9c43e3e6e641fbbb87789b48cf04ea~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_576,h_341,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_ec9c43e3e6e641fbbb87789b48cf04ea~mv2.jpg"]




Social Media Promotion & Events


Starting soon, we’ll be posting bi-weekly updates every Friday through our official social media accounts to introduce Connected Clue.
Please check the links below and give us a follow!



X (Twitter) : https://x.com/_alphe
YouTube : [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@_Alpheratz"][/dynamiclink]Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/alpheratz4869/
TikTok :  https://www.tiktok.com/@shw1208



We’re also running an RT campaign until Christmas (December 25).
Two winners will receive a $8.99 Steam digital gift card. Please join, retweet, and follow!


RT Event Tweet : https://x.com/shw1208/status/1966657788316418455



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_862d373932a14fc18bf69aad05d8356a~mv2.gif"]








Official Website Update


The character introduction section on the Connected Clue official site has been updated with new characters.



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_ef6f906eb69e46f7941c5006e1ffde3e~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_576,h_447,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_ef6f906eb69e46f7941c5006e1ffde3e~mv2.jpg"]


Please look forward to their stories and roles in the game!



https://www.connected-clue.com/








BIC Feedback & Gratitude


Thanks to all the feedback we received during BIC, we were able to polish Connected Clue even further.

Compared to our first showcase at BIC in 2023, the response this time was even more enthusiastic—making our game one of the most-reviewed titles at the event.
We are deeply grateful for your support, and we’ll continue working hard to create a fun and memorable experience.



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_2db8ba8329144832940fff92cc41eb29~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_576,h_720,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_2db8ba8329144832940fff92cc41eb29~mv2.jpg"]






Current Progress
QA is now in its final stage, and we’re currently working on English and Japanese translations of the main game.



During this translation period, we’re also preparing various content to keep players engaged and interested.

Meanwhile, development of our next project’s prototype is also underway. Once it’s ready, we’ll share more details.



Updates are ongoing, and patch notes are regularly posted on our Discord channel.
For the latest news on Connected Clue, feel free to join us there!

▶️ https://discord.gg/nCnhycdRN5









Additional updates not included in this devlog are often shared on X (formerly Twitter).
Please check them out here:



https://x.com/shw1208



Thank you once again for your continued support. We’ll be back soon with the next development log!

notes.title: Update Notes 27.
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839894/d09d11991af05e33c7dd6bd6e270fbd198bbe149.png"]

Hello, I'm Alpheratz*.   

 The contents of this development journal are as follows.      



2025 Comic World SUMMER / BIC Connect Pick, etc. Exhibition in Korea 

 Development status update  

 Testing and progress  

 future plans       



Homepage: https://www.connected-clue.com/     



We also opened steam shops and goods shops. Please show a lot of interest!     



Steam shops: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1777200/Connected_Clue/  

Goods shops: https://marpple.shop/kr/alpheratz4869         



Below are the images under development.            




2025 Comic World SUMMER / BIC Connect Pick to be held in Korea             


A demo version of "Connected Clue" will be displayed at Comic World SUMMER at KINTEX in Ilsan from July 19th to 20th in Korea.



Along with the PC version, the mobile version is also installed,  

Please visit the IC_10 booth and enjoy the game and give us lots of feedback!                 

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_ddb5777b25574055a5ddb5bd382a5829~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_486,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_ddb5777b25574055a5ddb5bd382a5829~mv2.jpg"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_6ba6e3d1538640a18f9f1faca70dc1f7~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_993,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_6ba6e3d1538640a18f9f1faca70dc1f7~mv2.jpg"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_d2d86d143cc848d2a3b53153f7ce54f7~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_473,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_d2d86d143cc848d2a3b53153f7ce54f7~mv2.jpg"]



 In addition, the 2025 BIC (Busan Indie Connect), which will be held at BEXCO in Busan, Korea on August 15-17, will also exhibit "Connected Clue."      



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_0d0f654e133348e7b40baf8d5bdaf653~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_879,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_0d0f654e133348e7b40baf8d5bdaf653~mv2.jpg"]



For those who have difficulty visiting the site, you can play on the official BIC page during the online exhibition from August 8 to 29, or from Stove Indie to Chapter 1.

 (We have previously sent the download link for the early access version, which is up to Chapter 2 to crowdfunding sponsors.)     



▶️ Online Exhibition Address: https://bicfest.org/exhibition/view/1641   

※ Online play is available after purchasing tickets.      



And we are holding a BIC online/offline free invitation lottery event until July 29th, so please participate.  

 ▶️ RT Events:   

Link 1:  https://x.com/shw1208/status/1944656948932338099   

Link 2:  https://x.com/_alphe/status/1944657492941918477      



▶️ Stove Indie: https://store.onstove.com/ko/games/101087                 








Development status update      

Add the ability to open the map page immediately when you click a mini-map     


We changed it to open the map page of the detective notes immediately when you click on the mini-map during play.   

This allows you to check your current location with a large map and set up navigation to specify your destination.             



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_2b83fcc69a3342119c51b6f6467bd18f~mv2.gif"]




Add a physical system to the detective wall    


 In the existing detective wall, there was no penalty even if the choice was wrong,  

 To add to the tension, I changed it to reduce your life if you misselected clues.  

 If you run out of life, it's a game over.             



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_4e93b4995681431c97c0b4c53ba4f8e9~mv2.gif"]




Add animation cut-in production when identifying the culprit     


 In providing conclusive evidence of the criminal,   

For a more dramatic production, we have inserted a cut-in animation.             



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_183262bd661e430c8fed57f09ee56640~mv2.gif"]




Improvement of sound wave effects in lockpick systems     


so that you can know more clearly when to open it   

High-frequency sound effects have been added, making it easier to detect open areas.            



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_92ee0d285bfd467caaa690b0021ff8bb~mv2.gif"]




Always add running options    
 

Based on feedback that the default movement speed is slow   

Added the option to set it to always go to the running state.                   



[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_b8742ac42d0f41598914bb023cf4f4a6~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_395,al_c,lg_1,q_80,enc_auto/104f30_b8742ac42d0f41598914bb023cf4f4a6~mv2.jpg"]






Testing and progress      
In July, players with abnormal color vision and hearing loss recruited through X (formerly Twitter) and some users

Full version of additional testing is in progress.      



Starting in August, we will deliver the project to the publishers   

We will be working on full-version translation and full QA, as well as preparing for Nintendo Switch console porting,   



Future development journals will mainly cover bug fixes, improved convenience, and news of exhibitions/press releases.        



Please feel free to send me any feedback on the game via Discord, DM, or email and I will try to reflect it in future updates.   



▶️ Discord channel: https://discord.gg/nCnhycdRN5         





We frequently upload the progress that is not written in the development log to X (old Twitter).   

Please refer to this side.    

https://x.com/shw1208           



We hope that this game will be completed into a fun game and repay everyone who helps.   

I'll come to you with the next development journal.

notes.title: Update Notes 25.
notes.content:
Hello, I'm Alphaatz*.
The contents of this Update Notes are as follows.

[olist]
 Improved keyboard operation
 Improved mobile operation
 Mobile resolution response
 Proceed with optimization
 Steam Mac OS support
 Ready to respond to Steam Deck
 Current Development Status
 2025 PlayX4/ July Comic World (in Korea)
[/olist]


HomePage :  https://www.connected-clue.com/
Steam shops and goods shops have also been opened, so please show a lot of interest!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1777200/Connected_Clue/
Goods shop : https://marpple.shop/kr/alpheratz4869
  

Below are the images under development.

 



Improved keyboard operation

Connected Clue is designed to play with  keyboard and  mouse, or  game controller.
We improve the inconvenience of operating the existing keyboard and adjust it to play games with just the keyboard.

In addition, when the player stands still without manipulating the character, the  manipulation guide  is displayed.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_fbf1d873dfec4ac48255b3759b1edc09~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_704,h_397,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_fbf1d873dfec4ac48255b3759b1edc09~mv2.png







Mobility improvement 

In mobile play, the player's movement due to the manipulation of the virtual game controller ,
It has been improved to move more smoothly in determining mutual objects and manipulating mini-games.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_f842c21ec54441fcbcea190dbbc5bcfb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_704,h_397,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_f842c21ec54441fcbcea190dbbc5bcfb~mv2.png

In addition, we solved the  game screenshot save  and import system of  when storing  on mobile.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_ecafd3ff14734a26b0f3fca2cbfdf604~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_704,h_415,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_ecafd3ff14734a26b0f3fca2cbfdf604~mv2.png





Resolution response 

Because the default resolution of the Connected Clue is 1920 * 1080, there was a problem that some UI was not displayed correctly in other resolutions.

Therefore, to support the resolution of various monitors and mobile devices
We are conducting tests to respond to various resolutions.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_b8f0050b789f466587d75d7c794475af~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_666,h_613,al_c,lg_1,q_90,enc_auto/104f30_b8f0050b789f466587d75d7c794475af~mv2.png

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_98baa5e390504dc2b13260357ce1e0f3~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_704,h_325,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_98baa5e390504dc2b13260357ce1e0f3~mv2.png







Optimization progress

We use Sprite Skin and Spine, which are our own animation tools supported by Unity Engine
However, due to the calculation problem of Sprite Skin and Spine
If there were many objects displayed on the screen, the frame rate would drop.


Optimization was performed to address this phenomenon, and the average frame rate could be improved dramatically.


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_5d4c374980384addac9c96d414d7cd58~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_430,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_5d4c374980384addac9c96d414d7cd58~mv2.jpg

그리고, 게임 기동시 기존에 30초 가량 걸렸던 로딩 시간을 대폭 단축해서 보다 쾌적하게 플레이할 수 있게 되었습니다.





Steam Mac OS Support 

High Sierra support for Mac OS on Steam has been discontinued, making games with x32 architecture impossible to run on Steam.
x64 architecture has been applied to the game build to allow the game to be played on Mac OS.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_8dd3a3d4d56b4bc7addddcf38ab4a082~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_396,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_8dd3a3d4d56b4bc7addddcf38ab4a082~mv2.jpg

I also fixed a bug that didn't find save files and screenshots when saving and fetching steam clouds from Mac OS.





Getting ready to respond to Steam Deck 

A virtual keyboard must be displayed when text is entered to support steaming.

Therefore, for future steam deck,  virtual keyboard was displayed.
The virtual keyboard is available not only on Steam Deck, but also on the Big Picture  version.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_8edf094d41714639b22f3c18dc5760bb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_704,h_396,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_8edf094d41714639b22f3c18dc5760bb~mv2.png

In addition, we are constantly testing the game to see if there are any inconveniences to play with the game controller .





The current development situation 

I finished my own QA of Early Access version  and asked publishers to do professional QA and  language translation .
 
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/104f30_e7cac4a856d14037a1760ddab58d5326~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_704,h_534,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/104f30_e7cac4a856d14037a1760ddab58d5326~mv2.jpg

During the QA and translation time of the full version of the game, May-July Tzum will send you a link to play the early access version to your supporters.

The Early Access version covers demo versions through Chapter 2  and has a playtime of 3 to 4 hours .

We will inform you of the details in the future development log.






2025 PlayX4/July Comic World 

From May 22nd to 25th , 2025 PlayX4  and
Comic World  scheduled for July will each participate as a booth.

Since I was a one-man developer, I had to keep the booth by myself, so I had one demonstration monitor in the meantime,
This time, we will deploy additional demonstration devices for testing mobile devices .

The demo version is updated at every exhibition, so please play it and give us a lot of feedback.
I'll let you know the detailed schedule and news later.




Please refer to the progress that does not appear in the development journal because it is posted more often on X (old Twitter).
https://x.com/shw1208


Then I'll do my best until the end so that I can repay you with fun games.
I'll come to you with the next development journal.
